units: <cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:5">Ukts. I, 5</cite> <he>פ׳ של אשכול שריקנה</he> (Talm. ed. <cite ref="Q01274"><he>פסיגא</he></cite>) a sprig of a vine when stripped of its grapes.—Pl. <he>פְּסִיגִין</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Peah 3:11">Tosef. Peah III, 11</cite> (expl. <he>כתף</he>) <he>פ׳ המחוברות וכ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>בסיגין</he>, Var. <he>סיגין</he>) sprigs which are joined to the trunk one above the other; Y. ib. VII, 20ᵃ bot. <he>פ׳ זו על גבי זו</he>.
